📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-12-rest-api-tables-endpoint-5xx-recurring-burst`
This is occurrence #5 in the last 7 days.
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `unmapped` (no rest-api row in ownership.md)
Playbook: 1) Confirm shape: monitor 70171778 fired, run sum:trace.aspnet_core.request.errors{env:prod,http.status_code:5*} by {service} for the alert window -- if concentrated on rest-api, this is very likely this pattern. 2) Break down further by {resource_name} on service:rest-api -- if concentrated on post_/api/v_version_/tables/_table (or a close sibling tables-endpoint resource), confirms the match. 3) Check service:rest-api status:error in DD Logs -- expect 0 hits (APM-only, no log corroboration is itself part of the signature -- NOTE: this occurrence found log corroboration in ES/Logstash instead, see below). 4) This is confirmed recurring (5+ known occurrences) with no code fix on file -- recommend actually filing the Jira defect that prior investigations recommended but apparently never filed.
Open Jira: n/a — fix_status: recurring-unconfirmed-root-cause (this occurrence supplies a concrete root cause for the first time — see Key finding below)

Source alerts (2 total, same underlying event):
  • n/a — degraded cycle (no Slack MCP; DD monitor scan diff, monitor 70171778 fired 2026-09-02T12:44:38Z)
  • n/a — degraded cycle (co-occurring generic Watchdog catch-all, monitor 236570583 fired 2026-09-02T12:58:33Z, same root cause — see docs/investigations/2026-09-02-89636a92b60f1520.md)

Root-cause analysis:
  • Query: sum:trace.aspnet_core.request.errors{env:prod,http.status_code:5*} by {service}.as_count(), 2026-09-02T12:14:38Z-12:44:38Z → 119 total, rest-api 101 (85%), by {resource_name} on rest-api → 101/101 (100%) on get_/api/v_version_/tables/_table. Matches this entry's documented signature.
  • **New this occurrence:** a wider ES/Logstash sweep (level.keyword:Error AND fields.dd_service.keyword:"rest-api", 12:28:33-12:58:33Z) returned 1140 hits (vs 25 in the same window 24h prior — ~45x). 1138/1140 (99.8%) on RequestPath /api/v1/tables/EdiOrders, all `System.Data.SqlClient.SqlException: Conversion failed when converting the nvarchar value '<value>' to data type int.` for account **kuumbamade2** (AccountId 157750), an integration client (UserAgent: node) calling `GET /api/v1/tables/EdiOrders?filter=id eq '731723-000486'&top=1` — a hyphenated PO-number-style string against an int-typed `id` column.
  • Reasoning: prior investigations of this entry only ever checked DD Logs (the Datadog product), which never had this data (0 hits, correctly) — they never checked ES/Logstash, which had the corroborating SqlException the entire time. This occurrence closes that gap.

Evidence (all queries run this cycle, non-empty):
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/70171778
  • DD monitor (co-occurring): https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/236570583
  • DD metric: https://app.datadoghq.com/metric/explorer?live=false&page=0&exp_metric=trace.aspnet_core.request.errors&exp_scope=env%3Aprod%2Cservice%3Arest-api&exp_agg=sum&start=1788351278&end=1788353078
  • Kibana: https://logstash.method.me/app/discover#/?_g=(time:(from:'2026-09-02T12:14:38Z',to:'2026-09-02T12:44:38Z'))&_a=(query:(language:kuery,query:'level.keyword%3AError%20and%20fields.dd_service.keyword%3A%22rest-api%22')) (1140 hits in the wider 12:28:33-12:58:33Z window)
  • This-window concentration: rest-api 1140 | nonprod/apps 497 (chronic WebView-timeout noise, flat vs 24h baseline, not related) | methodportal.com/apps 58 | method.ws/apps 44

Suggested next action: file a defect for Method.Data.RestApi.Controllers.TablesController.QueryRecordsAsync / GlobalExceptionHandler to return 400 (not an unhandled 500) on a SQL type-conversion failure; separately flag account kuumbamade2's integration (UserAgent: node) for sending malformed `id` filter values to /api/v1/tables/EdiOrders.

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-07-02-miurl-agent-account-cluster-internal-lookup`

Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Transactions` (`@transactions` / `#team-transactions`) — ownership.md name-match; monitor's own tags say `team:vae`, conflict unresolved, flagged not guessed.
Playbook: Confirm 100% of errors land on resource_name GET .../account/v3/cluster/internal/account (not a new incident); check ms-account-api co-firing (none observed); do not re-derive root cause each fire — diagnosis is stable, only magnitude changes; root cause still needs repo access (blocked, see below).

Note: fixed a stale match.channels on this KB entry (was alert-system only; monitor's real live channel is alert-runtime-monitoring) — caused a false-negative KB match this cycle, corrected in kb/known-issues.json. Deploy correlation on legacy-miurl-api/MIURLAgent blocked (methodcrm-org GH_TOKEN 403, standing gap; local clone ~4mo stale). Root cause still unconfirmed against source after 7 occurrences over 2 months — fix_status remains needs-human, no Jira filed.

📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout`
This is occurrence #756 (last occurrence 2026-08-31, ~50.5h ago — past the 24h suppression window, chronic steady-state pattern, not a magnitude escalation).
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Admin` (`@admin` / `#team-admin`)
Playbook: 1) Confirm chronic baseline (ES Ocelot warning volume vs 24h-ago — delta <20% = chronic). 2) Aggregate by RequestPath (all upstream microservices.methodlocal.int). 3) Check ki-dns-microservices-method-int-pps-quota first (DNS bursts can present as Ocelot timeouts). 4) Identify slow downstream via Ocelot config if DNS is clean. 5) Fix decision tree: raise per-route timeout / scale microservices IIS pool / profile upstream service.
Open Jira: none

Source alerts (1 total):
  • n/a — degraded cycle (no Slack MCP this session), synthetic alert from DD monitor 77419271 fired 2026-09-02T18:50:11Z

Evidence:
  • DD monitor: https://app.datadoghq.com/monitors/77419271
  • DD logs (monitor's exact query): https://app.datadoghq.com/logs?query=service%3Amethod-ui%20-%2AResizeObserver%2A%20-%2Asegment%2A%20-%2Asignalr%2A%20-%2Amixpanel%2A%20-%2Ahotjar%2A%20-%22Minified%20Redux%20error%22%20status%3Aerror%20%2Axhr%2A&from_ts=1788375911000&to_ts=1788376211000&live=false
  • Kibana: https://logstash.method.me/app/discover#/?_g=(time:(from:'2026-09-02T18:20:11Z',to:'2026-09-02T18:50:11Z'))&_a=(query:(language:kuery,query:'GetSyncWidgetInfoAsync'))
  • This-window concentration: gateway 696 (100%) | vs 774 same-window 24h-ago (-10.1%, chronic not surge)

Corroboration detail: 200-sample DD-logs cross-check of the monitor's exact query shows 154/200 (77%) on the syncutil/syncwidget/<account>/GetSyncWidgetInfoAsync path, status_code:0, diffuse across many accounts (top account only 6% of sample) — not a single-account/bot artifact. Full ES stack trace on one sample record: RequestTimedOutError -> TaskCanceledException -> IOException -> SocketException(125) at the Ocelot HTTP-connection layer, matching the KB's documented mechanism verbatim. No co-fire with ki-24 (RTC p95) this window.
